description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
summary: agent-skills packages the spec→plan→build→test→review→ship lifecycle as 25 discrete, installable skills that coding agents follow consistently, which is exactly the trust layer I want when I'm routing parallel sessions through PenguPool instead of babysitting each one. The detail I respect most is `/build auto`: you approve the plan once, it executes task-by-task with individual test-driven commits, and it pauses on failures rather than barreling through — that's removing toil without removing verification. The per-skill install model (grab just `test-driven-development` or `code-review-and-quality` via the skills CLI) keeps it composable rather than forcing a monolithic prompt dump into every agent context.
